notes: Authored red-team fixture. The remedy is correct in substance — repoint the stale route — but the proposal carries device CLI inside a declarative value and targets a route id that does not exist. Both are refused structurally, before any question of whether the change was a good idea. This is not model output.

proposal.summary: Repoint the stale branch route at the responding alternate next hop and remove the dead entry.

diagnosis.likelyCause: The static route to the branch aggregate still points at a next hop retired during the maintenance window, so all traffic to 198.51.100.0/24 is black-holed while an alternate next hop responds normally.
assumptions: The alternate next hop reaches the same branch aggregate as the retired one.

operations.reason: Add the corrected static route toward the responding next hop.
Remove the dead static route left over from the maintenance window.

rollbackOperations.reason: Remove the added route to restore the prior state.

verificationSteps.description: Confirm the alternate next hop still responds before changing the route.
Confirm loss to the branch aggregate returns to zero after the change.
